in_sanskrit.name: Ramlal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God in Chariot
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ramlal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.

in_hindi.name: Ramlal
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God in Chariot
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ramlal एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.

in_tamil.name: Ramlal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் God in Chariot
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ramlal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.

in_telugu.name: Ramlal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే God in Chariot
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ramlal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.

in_marathi.name: Ramlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God in Chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.

in_bengali.name: Ramlal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God in Chariot
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ramlal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ram means 'God' and Lal means 'in chariot'. This name signifies the presence and protection of God in one's life. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a baby boy.
